source.notes: WebFetch on this URL reported 'unable to extract text' but the PDF was saved locally; the Read tool was then used directly on that local file path, which parsed the full 57-page PDF text natively (not summarized by an intermediate model). The document's own title page reads 'KENYA INSTITUTE OF CURRICULUM DEVELOPMENT ... JUNIOR SCHOOL CURRICULUM DESIGN ... MATHEMATICS ... GRADE 9', First published 2024, ISBN 978-9914-43-431-6 — consistent with the official KICD Google Drive filename confirmed in this repo's README ('Mathematics Grade 9 - July 2024 - Revised.pdf', Drive file ID 1HgntYl8nS1zydy8k00KrjEt_zJiMqISL) and with the mirror's own filename/title ('Mathematics-Grade-9-July-2024-Revised.pdf'). All strand/sub-strand headings, specific learning outcomes, and key inquiry questions below were transcribed verbatim from the Read output of the actual PDF text, not paraphrased or inferred. One minor internal inconsistency in the source itself is worth flagging: the 'SUMMARY OF STRANDS AND SUB-STRANDS' table (p.xii) lists sub-strand 2.2 as 'Equation of a Straight Line' (singular), while the detailed strand section heading on p.10 reads '2.2 Equations of Straight Lines' (plural) — this JSON uses the summary table's naming for the sub-strand 'name' field and records the variant in that sub-strand's notes.
